turn.question: Draft the award memo for the VP.
turn.answer: The award memo for the VP has been drafted and saved to `Award_Memo_RFX_2026_PKG_017_docx.docx`. It summarizes the vendor eligibility, the proposed award split, and the urgent need to verify the unconfirmed pricing from Ganesh Kraft Traders before execution.

sections.body:
Following the RFX-2026-PKG-017 competitive bidding process, we have evaluated five vendors: Vardhan Packaging Works, Bhiwandi Corrugated Industries, Sahyadri Boxes & Sheets, Ganesh Kraft Traders, and Nakoda Paper Packs. 

The evaluation was strictly limited to vendors who met our quality hard requirements (ISO 9001 certification and in-house ECT/BCT testing). Only Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders cleared these requirements. Vendors Bhiwandi Corrugated Industries and Sahyadri Boxes & Sheets failed due to outsourced testing, while Nakoda Paper Packs' documentation was unclear.
sections.heading: Overview and Eligibility

sections.body:
Based on the lowest price per line among the two qualified vendors, we propose an award split that covers all 30 line items. Vardhan Packaging Works will be awarded 10 lines, and Ganesh Kraft Traders will be awarded 20 lines. 

The total estimated value for this award is 58,979,707 INR. This allocation assumes the lowest cost per line while ensuring all requirements are met. Please note that no vendor provided freight estimates; therefore, these costs are strictly ex-tax and ex-freight.
sections.heading: Award Recommendation and Financial Impact

sections.body: It is critical to note that the pricing for Ganesh Kraft Traders, which constitutes a significant portion of this award, relies on 30 line-item quotes extracted from a rate card image (`rate_card_photo.jpg`). These values are marked as 'medium confidence' and are subject to multiple open review items. We strongly advise manual verification of these line-item values against the official source document before signing the final contracts.
sections.heading: Risk and Recommendation for Verification
